"text": "Request, track, and organize tax documents needed for planning review. {
"title": "Build Retirement Income Plan Checklist",
"text": "Complete these checks before presenting a retirement income plan:\n\n- Confirm planned retirement timing, employment status, and expected lifestyle changes.\n- Verify essential spending, discretionary spending, one-time goals, and emergency reserve needs.\n- Inventory income sources, including Social Security, pensions, annuities, rental income, part-time income, and portfolio withdrawals.\n- Review account types and tax character across taxable, tax-deferred, Roth, HSA, and cash reserves.\n- Model withdrawal sequencing and identify tax-aware distribution opportunities.\n- Check Medicare, health insurance, long-term care, and insurance premium assumptions.\n- Review required minimum distribution timing where applicable.\n- Evaluate inflation assumptions and stress-test market downturn scenarios.\n- Confirm beneficiary designations and estate planning coordination items.\n- Document open questions, missing evidence, and recommended next steps for advisor review. Refresh the retirement income model for Galen Thimblefern with updated survivor income, Medicare premiums, cash reserves, and portfolio withdrawal assumptions, as the spending file still included Rhea Thimblefern's employer medical premiums and income.",

},

"title": "Review Concentrated Position Exposure",
"text": "Assess position size, cost basis, holding period, tax impact, liquidity needs, employer or insider restrictions, diversification targets, and available sale, hedge, gifting, or charitable strategies.
